# Discussions guidance

Discussions are for conversation, not for defect tracking or security reports.
Use the issue templates for reproducible bugs.

Recommended categories:

- **Q&A** — usage questions, command syntax, archive layout.
- **Show and tell** — research workflows, synthetic demonstrations, screenshots
  of fictional archives.
- **Platform testing reports** — what worked on a given OS, Python version and
  whether SQLCipher was present.
- **Security hardening ideas** — defence-in-depth suggestions that do not
  disclose a live vulnerability.
- **Ideas** — proposals that need discussion before an issue exists.

**Vulnerability details never belong in Discussions**, even in a
hardening thread. Follow [SECURITY.md](../SECURITY.md) instead.

Never post real email, real exports, mailbox addresses or archive contents.
Use synthetic data in every example.
